title: Knights of Camelot vs Cosán Sí Host
lede:
The Knights of Camelot beat the Cosán Sí Host 30-10 on Victory Points, reaching the 30 VP target in Battle Round 5 without the Host ever scoring an objective.

Merlin and the Knight-Excisors walked onto the centre in Round 1 and never left it: five Sidhe units fought them in melee from Round 2 to 5 for 4 damage on the Excisors and none on Merlin, while the Parish Militia's OC beside them kept the 3 VP centre Camelot's every round.
result_line: Knights of Camelot win 30-10 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment:
Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Knights of Camelot brought six units and their HQ at (7,13), and put five of them on the left of row 12: Knight-Ascendants with the Knight-Banneret at (3,12), Knight-Scourgers at (4,12) and Knight-Excisors with Merlin - Wizard of Avalon at (5,12), with only the Parish Militia right of centre at (9,12). The Cosán Sí Host set up ten units across rows 1 and 2 in front of its HQ at (7,1): Rootwall Dryads 1 and 2 at (3,1) and (5,1) and the Barghest at (9,1) behind; Coblynau Sappers 2 at (4,2), the Blackflint Archers at (5,2), Sidhe Wardens 1 with the Waymarshal at (7,2), Sidhe Wardens 2 with the Sidhe Druid at (9,2) and Coblynau Sappers 1 at (11,2). Camelot had Priority with fewer units on the battlefield (7 to 11).

The set-up aimed Camelot's elite knights at the left and the centre and left the right flank to nobody. The Host had numbers but little punch: 5-HP Warden squads, Sappers built to tunnel, and two slow 18-HP Dryad squads.

1.title: Merlin takes the centre on a Double Time

feed.text: Primaries revealed: GARRISON DUTY for Camelot, IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS for the Host. Secondaries kept: DEEP REACH and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY. The Flow of Magic rolled Stone for the Host. Archimagus Supremus gave Camelot 1 Mana and a fourth Gatescroll token, and Camelot spent 2 of its 3 CP on Double Time for the Knight-Excisors.

The Double Time put the Knight-Excisors and Merlin straight onto the centre at 6,7. Knight-Ascendants and the Knight-Banneret advanced to 2,8 on the left objective; the Knight-Scourgers came to 4,9 and the Parish Militia to 9,8. The Host advanced everything a few squares: the Wardens to 9,6 and 5,5, the Barghest to 5,4, the Dryads to 3,4 and 6,4, the Sappers to 9,4 and 2,5, the Blackflint Archers to 8,5.

The Host's 1 CP Go to Ground on the Blackflint Archers made the Knight-Excisors' Four-Bore Rifles miss (0 from 3 at -3 to HIT). The Archers put 7 of 8 arrows on Merlin, Cambion Prophetic Sight's EVASION turned 3 aside and the Excisors took 4 (12 to 8, a model). Merlin's Staff of Avalon hit once and the Archers' WARD saved it; they used Fading Step back to 7,3.

Camelot took the centre (OC 8 vs 0) and the left (OC 14 vs 0), 5 VP, and DEEP REACH paid 3 at once: on this map all three objectives are 6 squares from Camelot's HQ, so the centre counted as the furthest. 8-0.

2.title: The Knight-Scourgers die in the middle of five Sidhe units, and take one with them

feed.text: The Flow of Magic rolled Surge. Camelot spent Double Time on the Knight-Scourgers (2 CP), the Host on the Blackflint Archers (2 CP). Secondaries kept: FORWARD DEPLOYMENT and PROBING STRIKE.

The Knight-Scourgers ran to 7,6 under a 1 CP Go to Ground from Merlin and took 2 from the Wardens' Overwatch. The Archers used their Double Time to reach 2,6, inside the left objective's area; the Knight-Banneret's Overwatch at them rolled nothing, its FREE pistol already marked used. Knight-Ascendants and the Banneret charged the Archers at 2,7, Coblynau Sappers 2 slipped to 0,7, and the Parish Militia stepped to 8,8. Then the Host charged the Knight-Scourgers with five units: Coblynau Sappers 1, Rootwall Dryads 2, Sidhe Wardens 1 with the Waymarshal, the Barghest, and Sidhe Wardens 2 with the Sidhe Druid, who also engaged Merlin and the Excisors.

The Knight-Banneret called Heroic Hour (+2 AR, +1 DMG) and cut down three Blackflint Archers (5 to 2), who stepped away to 1,3 and put 3 into the Knight-Ascendants (12 to 9). Sidhe Wardens 1 put 5 into the Knight-Scourgers (10 to 5), the Waymarshal 3 more and Rootwall Dryads 2 the last 2: Knight-Scourgers destroyed, and the Dryads took ground at 7,6. In the centre Sidhe Wardens 2 struck first for 2 on the Excisors (8 to 6), and the Excisors and Merlin answered with 3 (5 to 2). Both Sappers squads used Tunnel Burrow and left the board. At the phase's end BURNED, which the Knight-Scourgers' Armor of Cold Flame puts on a melee attacker that damages them, did 2 to the Waymarshal (6 to 4) and 4 to Sidhe Wardens 1, destroyed.
Camelot held the centre on OC 18 vs 13, the Parish Militia's 10 models the difference, and the left on OC 14 vs 0: 5 VP. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid the Host 2. 13-2.

3.title: Four attacks on Merlin, no damage

feed.text: The Flow of Magic rolled Water. Camelot kept TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET and the Host named the empty right objective (13,7); the Host kept DEEP REACH and PROBING STRIKE expired. Camelot put Double Time on the Knight-Banneret (2 CP); the Host spent a Rally Cry on Sidhe Wardens 2 (2 CP).

The Sappers came back out of Tunnel Burrow at 3,2, in their own back line, and 2,12, beside Camelot's deployment zone, then walked to 5,3 and 5,12. Knight-Ascendants and the Banneret charged Rootwall Dryads 1 at 2,6, still inside the left objective's area; the Dryads failed their Fall Back test and broke away to 0,3 (2 damage). Rootwall Dryads 2 fell back from Merlin to 5,5. The Barghest and the Waymarshal charged Merlin and the Excisors from 5,6 and 7,6. The Parish Militia moved to 6,8, under the centre pair.

Merlin swung at the Barghest and missed; the Barghest hit him twice for no damage. The Waymarshal, Sidhe Wardens 2 and the Sidhe Druid all attacked Merlin: EVASION and misses, nothing landed. The Blackflint Archers shot the Parish Militia for 4 (20 to 16). BURNED took 2 more off the Waymarshal (4 to 2).
The centre (OC 16 vs 7) and the left (OC 14 vs 0), 5 VP; GARRISON DUTY paid 1 for the Knight-Excisors, which had counterattacked the Waymarshal that phase. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid 3. 19-5.

4.title: The Parish Militia shoot the Archers down; the left is left empty

feed.text: The Flow of Magic rolled Stone again; Rootwall Dryads 1 regenerated 2 HP. Camelot kept COMMAND AUTHORITY and then spent none of its 5 CP. The Host kept ASSASSINATION and put Double Time on the Blackflint Archers (2 CP). Sidhe Wardens 2 failed Morale on a natural 1 and was SUPPRESSED. FORWARD DEPLOYMENT expired.

Knight-Ascendants and the Banneret charged the Barghest from 2,6 to 4,7, off the left objective, and the Barghest broke away to 4,9. The Archers ran to 8,7 and the Parish Militia's Overwatch shot their last 2 HP away: Blackflint Archers destroyed. Rootwall Dryads 2's charge failed and it did not move.

Merlin's attack on the Waymarshal missed and the Waymarshal's counter did nothing. Sidhe Wardens 2 hit Merlin once for no damage, and the Knight-Excisors' counterattack finished them: Sidhe Wardens 2 destroyed. The Druid's staff missed. Coblynau Sappers 1 burrowed again.

Camelot scored the centre only (OC 16 vs 2), 3 VP: nobody stood on the left. GARRISON DUTY paid 2 for the Knight-Excisors and the Parish Militia, both of which had just destroyed a unit (by counterattack and by Overwatch). IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid the Host 2. 24-7.

The Flow of Magic rolled Tree. Camelot spent 7 of its 8 CP: Troop Requisition (5) placed a second Parish Militia at 6,13 and Double Time (2) sent it forward. The Host put Double Time on the Sidhe Druid (2 CP). The Waymarshal failed Morale on a natural 1 (SUPPRESSED) and so did the Druid. Secondaries kept: KING OF THE HILL and STRONGPOINT; COMMAND AUTHORITY and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY expired.

Coblynau Sappers 1 emerged at 3,2 again and walked back to 5,3, where it had stood in Round 3. The Druid broke away from Merlin in disorder (2 damage) to 5,4. Knight-Ascendants returned to the left objective at 2,8; the new Parish Militia reached 9,10. Coblynau Sappers 2 came up to 4,7 (the Banneret's Overwatch again rolled nothing on its used FREE weapon), Rootwall Dryads 2 charged Merlin and the Excisors at 6,6, and the Barghest ran into the centre's area at 8,7 through 8 Overwatch shots that all missed.

Merlin put 3 into Rootwall Dryads 2 (18 to 15). The Waymarshal hit the Excisors for 2 (6 to 4, a model). The Parish Militia shot the Barghest: five hits, three evaded, 1 damage (7 to 6). Coblynau Sappers 2 burrowed again.

The centre (OC 14 vs 6) and the left (OC 14 vs 0), 5 VP, and GARRISON DUTY 1 for the Knight-Excisors: 30, the target. The Host scored IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS 2 and STRONGPOINT 1 for the Waymarshal, the Barghest and Rootwall Dryads 2 in the centre's area. 30-10, Knights of Camelot win.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Knights of Camelot scored 23 objective VP, 15 from the centre in all five rounds and 8 from the left in Rounds 1, 2, 3 and 5, plus 4 from GARRISON DUTY and 3 from DEEP REACH in Round 1. The Cosán Sí Host scored no objective VP at all: 9 from IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS, which pays for units standing outside its deployment zone in good order, and 1 from STRONGPOINT. Its best Primary round was 3 VP; Camelot's objectives alone paid 5 in four rounds of five.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The 13 RP Parish Militia was the best buy on the table: 9.0 VP, 6 of them hinged on it, 69.2 per 100 RP. Its ten models were the OC that kept the centre (18 vs 13 in Round 2, the closest count of the battle), and its Overwatch destroyed the Blackflint Archers. Merlin - Wizard of Avalon and the Knight-Excisors stood on 6,7 from Round 1 to the end: the Host charged them with Sidhe Wardens 2, the Sidhe Druid, the Waymarshal, the Barghest and Rootwall Dryads 2, and with Cambion Prophetic Sight's 5+ EVASION the Knight-Excisors lost 8 HP in five rounds, half of it to the Blackflint Archers' arrows in Round 1, and Merlin ended on 8 of 8. Knight-Ascendants and the Knight-Banneret held the left (4.2 VP each); the Ascendants never made an attack, but their charges drove Rootwall Dryads 1 and the Barghest away in Rounds 3 and 4.

The Host's damage came from the Blackflint Archers (11) and Sidhe Wardens 1 (6) before both died. Its 50 RP Waymarshal did 5. The only Camelot unit it destroyed, the Knight-Scourgers, burned two of their killers on the way out: Armor of Cold Flame's BURNED destroyed Sidhe Wardens 1 and took 4 HP off the Waymarshal. Damage came out even, 27 each, Camelot's including 8 from BURNED and 4 from the Host's disordered Fall Backs; the trade in units was three (64 RP) for one (45 RP).

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Host could not do

  • Take an objective. It had units in the centre's area at every Cleanup from Round 2 to 5 (OC 13, 7, 2 and 6) and never out-counted Camelot there; the left belonged to the Knight-Ascendants; the right, which nobody held, it never walked to.
  • Hurt the centre pair. From Round 3 on, nine melee attacks on Merlin and the Excisors did 2 damage.
  • Its secondaries: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and DEEP REACH needed an objective; ASSASSINATION needed a CHARACTER or MONSTER, and the CHARACTERs here were Merlin behind his EVASION and the Banneret with the Ascendants; PROBING STRIKE needed attacks on three units in Camelot's half in one Action Phase, and the Host fought in its own. Only STRONGPOINT, two units in an Objective Area, came off, in Round 5.
  • The Coblynau Sappers spent four Tunnel Burrows going round in circles: they emerged at 3,2, their own back line, twice, and at 2,12, and never stood on an objective at a round's end. Coblynau Sappers 2 was in the left objective's area at 0,7 in Round 2 and burrowed out of it.

Camelot's own failed secondaries: FORWARD DEPLOYMENT wanted no unit within 5 squares of its HQ and the Parish Militia stood exactly 5 away at 8,8 and 6,8; TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET was the right objective, where Camelot sent nobody; COMMAND AUTHORITY is below; KING OF THE HILL saw no kill in Round 5.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • GARRISON DUTY paid for units that fought. The card scores units that neither moved nor attacked, but all 4 of its VP came from units that attacked that round: the Knight-Excisors counterattacked in Rounds 3, 4 and 5 (in Round 4 destroying Sidhe Wardens 2) and the Parish Militia's Overwatch destroyed the Blackflint Archers in Round 4. That is a rules problem, not an AI one: the card reads a flag only an Action Phase attack sets. Without those 4 VP Camelot would have stood on 26 after Round 5.
  • Round 2, Knight-Scourgers: Camelot's AI spent Double Time to run its 45 RP knights into the middle of the Host, where five units charged them. It was Camelot's only loss.
  • Round 4, COMMAND AUTHORITY: Camelot kept a card that wanted any HQ Command on a unit in the enemy half, had 5 CP and the Knight-Ascendants at 2,6 in that half, and issued nothing. In Round 5 its 7 CP went on a Troop Requisition and a Double Time in its own half, and the card expired.
  • Round 4, the left: the Knight-Ascendants charged the Barghest off the left objective, the Barghest fell back, and the left's 2 VP went unscored.
  • Merlin's Mana: Camelot had 3 Mana from Round 3 and 5 by Round 5, enough for Pellinore's Slumber (3) or Banner of the Cinder Dragon (4), and Merlin never cast; he swung Caliburn every round for 4 damage in all.
  • The Host's Sappers and Dryads: the Tunnel Burrow loops above, Rootwall Dryads 1 idle in four rounds, and Rootwall Dryads 2 falling back from Merlin in Round 3 and failing its charge in Round 4.
  • Overwatch with a FREE weapon rolled nothing: the Knight-Banneret's Overwatch on the Blackflint Archers (Round 2) and on Coblynau Sappers 2 (Round 5) was skipped, its pistol already marked used.
  • The Fall Back record is inflated by the AI's charge-planning probes: all nine 'risky holds' and four other 'stayed' entries (Sidhe Wardens 1 in Round 2, the Parish Militia in Rounds 4 and 5, Camelot's HQ in Round 5) name engagers that were never adjacent.

The army decided this one: Camelot's elite pair on the centre could not be hurt by what the Host brought, and a cheap militia gave it the OC. The Host's AI added little, but it had no unit that could shift Merlin.

closing: Merlin and the Knight-Excisors took the centre in Round 1 and the Host spent four rounds hitting them for 8 HP in all. With the Parish Militia's OC beside them and the Knight-Ascendants on the left, Camelot scored objectives every round and the Host never did.
